substeps.caption: The door opens on its left-hand hinge.
A steel substrate plate goes onto the bed.
Door shut; the chamber fills with argon. Drawn see-through from here.
Six 200 W diode lasers converge on the wire fed through the head's centre; a bead of metal follows the head.
Up a layer, and round again: a wall one bead wide (beads drawn about 5x).
Lasers off; the head lifts. 1400 mm tall, about twice what the VLM's opening takes, so it stands beside the VLM.
